title: The "Quick Nap" Gamble
premise: That dangerous moment you decide to take a "20-minute power nap."

visual_beats: Realistic AI scene. A person collapses onto a bed in broad daylight, wearing a hoodie. They set a phone alarm for 20 minutes with a confident smirk. NARRATION:

narration: (Action: Cut to the person waking up in total darkness. They look panicked. They check the phone.)
(Dialogue - Voiceover, whispered and horrified): "Wait... is it 6:00 PM or 6:00 AM?
(Action: They sit up slowly. A single, distant bird chirps. They check the date on the phone. Their eyes widen.)
(Dialogue - Voiceover): "I've slept through an entire fiscal quarter.

visual_beats: Cut to a shot of the person staring blankly at the wall while the "Windows Shutdown" sound plays. NARRATION:
